raw: “I remember a foul puddle in a public shower. There was a clump of hair across the drain, and gray suds were pooling around my sandals. The hair really disgusted me, but then I noticed the suds around my feet, and that felt worse—it wasn’t just something over by the drain. I kept looking between the clump of hair and the water around my sandals. Just the thought of standing in that puddle made me want to get away from it.”
